I'm requesting documents for case B-002. The registry filing is dated 2026-01-11, which makes it more than 9 months old at the 2026-10-27 review. SOP 3.5 requires a filing less than 6 months old, so we need a current one from the customer.

- **Ownership (3.2–3.4):** this part is complete. The three listed owners add up to 100% (Yilmaz 43%, Ishikawa 36%, Castillo 21%), and the certification matches. Sven Yilmaz is the control person as CEO. All three IDs are verified.
- **Industry (5.2–5.3):** the entity is a money services business, which would normally go to Enhanced Due Diligence. It doesn't here because its state licence has been verified, and 5.3 allows that case to be approved.
- **Screening and geography (Section 4 and 6.1–6.2):** no sanctions matches, no politically exposed persons, and no adverse media reported. The entity and all three owners are in the US.
- **Search records:** the adverse media results come back as a plain "no", with no search terms, dates or sources recorded, which 4.4 requires. On its own that would make the case incomplete. Requesting documents is the more severe outcome, so under 2.1 it takes priority. The search records still need to be filled in before the case could be approved.
